'''Chapter 553''' is titled "Summit Battle".

==Cover Page==
[[Color spreads|Color spread]]: the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] enjoying ice cream.

==Short Summary==
The war finally begins with [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]] creating two tsunamis converging from both sides of [[Marineford]], but [[Kuzan|Aokiji]] quickly freezes both tsunamis, causing great relief. He then goes on to attack Whitebeard, who counter attacks and demolishes Aokiji, causing him to start falling into the ocean. Aokiji freezes the ocean before he is submerged, immobilizing the ships but also creating some footing. All 14 commanders then rush out of the ship and charge into the war, leading the rest of the allies. The pirates start to open fire onto Marineford, but their attacks are blocked by the Vice-Admirals. [[Dracule Mihawk]] decides to test his strength against Whitebeard, but his attempt is stopped by [[Jozu]], revealing his power. [[Borsalino|Kizaru]] also comes into play and aims for Whitebeard, but is also stopped by [[Polo Marco|Marco]], revealing his power.

==Long Summary==
The [[Marines]] are in panic as two tsunamis advance towards them. [[Donquixote Doflamingo]] laughs at the "Legendary Pirate" Whitebeard, while the great pirate himself also laughs. Soon, Aokiji evaporates out of his chair and uses [[Hie Hie no Mi|Ice Age]] on the two tsunamis, freezing them entirely. Whitebeard calls Aokiji a "little rascal," while the Marines are relieved. Aokiji sends Ice Spears towards Whitebeard, who stops them and snaps Aokiji in half, [[Gura Gura no Mi|cracking the air]] to do this. Aokiji crumbles into ice, but reforms near the water and freezes the bay entirely, creating an icy battlefield. The [[Whitebeard Pirates]] look out, observing the new foothold but the fact that they no longer could move. The Marines fire upon the ships, when Whitebeard's allies jump out, getting ready to fight.

The [[Vice Admiral]]s of Marine Headquarters jump down and line up, all holding swords. The opposition comment on their line up, stating that this rarely happens and looks like a [[Buster Call]]. [[Tsuru]] is warned to stay back, but states that even if she was to retreat to the end of the Seas, she would never be safe.

Mihawk pulls out [[Yoru|his legendary sword]] and tells Doflamingo that he was going to test the strength between a certain man and him. Mihawk sends a gigantic flying strike towards Whitebeard but is suddenly stopped by "Diamond" Jozu, the Third Division Commander. Next, Kizaru prepares to take his strike, sending a [[Pika Pika no Mi|shower of light bullets]] towards Whitebeard. The old pirate comments that the light was bright and as the shower comes, Marco, the First Division Commander, jumps up into the fray, stopping the shower in [[Tori Tori no Mi, Model: Phoenix|blue flames]]. Marco states that Kizaru could not take the king on his first turn, while Kizaru states that the Whitebeard Pirates are frightening people.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Polo Marco|Marco]] and [[Jozu]] are both revealed to have eaten [[Devil Fruit]]s. Jozu's gives him [[Kira Kira no Mi|diamond coating]] while Marco's is able to stop an attack from [[Borsalino|Kizaru]] with [[Tori Tori no Mi, Model: Phoenix|blue fire]].
*[[Onigumo]], a [[vice admiral]], has recently been seen with [[Onigumo#Devil Fruit|six arms sprouting from his back]]. Using this and his original two arms, Onigumo is capable of holding eight swords.
